description: Search the video studio's library of characters, scenes, props and music (ready assets every studio has): each entry is a ref to put into a VideoSpec (lib:office-guy@1), its kind (actor | set | prop | music), style family, title, tags, what it can do and its tier (base — free for everyone, premium — opened by a pack). Every word of the query must match; filter by kind and style. Read-only; takes no title_id.

query.description: Words to match in title, tags and what it can do (tags are in en and ru). Empty — all.

style.description: Style family, e.g. voxel-warm or chibi-2d.

name: search_assets
title: Search video assets
